name: Hindaun

routes.httpStatus: Discovery result available; official page readable
routes.outcome: Government of India DILRMP page for Rajasthan/Karauli lists Hindaun tehsil: 323 cadastral maps/FMBs, 323 villages, 323 digitized maps, 100% geo-referenced maps, 115899 total land parcels and 115899 geo-referenced parcels. This is administrative coverage evidence, not a parcel feature response.

Official Rajasthan Urban GIS Portal loaded. It exposes District, City/ULB, Khasra Search, View On Map, View Khasra Info and navigation controls, and identifies Settlement Department khasra/village boundaries as map inputs. Its disclaimer limits the data to viewing and says official local-body records control legal authentication.

Current public viewer configuration was readable. The KHASARA layer is https://gisprod.rajasthan.gov.in/geocode/rest/services/JDA/Settlement_JDA/MapServer/0, a JDA-specific layer; no Hindaun/Karauli service URL was exposed in this configuration.

Current JavaScript confirms the Khasra layer uses ArcGIS FeatureLayer/queryFeatures with returnGeometry=true and outFields=*, and the viewer performs bounded spatial Khasra queries. No Hindaun parcel response was requested from the JDA-specific layer.
